classification.difficultyReason: Identify three sectors on one side of a straight line and subtract the two given angles.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 4, beneath the stem at left
spec.description: Five arrow-ended rays, comprising two intersecting straight lines and an additional upward ray. Labels occupy the original sectors; no arcs or fills.
spec.mathematics: The upward ray and upper-left steep arm enclose 30 degrees. The upward ray and lower-right shallow arm enclose 125 degrees. The two lower-right arms enclose x degrees. Thus 30+125+x=180.
spec.answerVisibility: Only 30°, 125° and x° appear; the completed answer is excluded.

answer.worked:
Angles on a straight line sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}x&=180^\circ-125^\circ-30^\circ\\x&=25^\circ\end{align*}$$
